anya_legal: I'll prepare a brief telemetry addendum (retention 45d, anonymize host identifiers). Also confirm marketing review flow.

bench-bot: bench scheduled id 2026-PG-01. Command: `./bench --cfg pegs_edge_v1.json --target 10.22.3.9` :rocket:

lee_partners: Thanks — action items: Omar upload artifacts + blurb; Jean prep harness; Anya draft addendum; Nina reserve rack. Check-in Fri AM.
